items.headline: Why Is Albemarle (ALB) Up 5.4% Since Last Earnings Report?
items.snippet: Albemarle posted second-quarter 2026 adjusted earnings of $3.75 per share, up from 11 cents a year ago, beating the Zacks Consensus Estimate of $3.35 by 11.9%, supported by stronger lithium pricing, Specialties growth and productivity gains.

items.headline: Albemarle's Lithium Math Turns Brutal
items.snippet: JPMorgan now expects lithium prices to remain in the low-$20-per-kilogram range. Albemarle faces delays at the Greenbushes CGP3 plant following a June fire; the plant restarted Aug. 1. ALB Price Action: Albemarle shares were down 5.16% at $134.21 at the time of publication.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $225 from $245 at Truist
items.snippet: Truist analyst Peter Osterland lowered the firm's price target on Albemarle to $225 from $245 and keeps a Buy rating on the shares, citing resilient lithium demand and constrained supply dynamics.
